payload.intent: Expand real-time telemetry signals beyond drift and sentiment into an economic, operational, semantic, relational and temporal signal layer usable at single-interaction and organisation-wide levels.

metrics.meaning: Frequency and magnitude of goal shifts across turns.
metrics.single_view_value: Detect confusion, pivot, or buying/decision cues mid-conversation.
metrics.org_view_value: Expose product-market and message misalignment clusters.

metrics.meaning: Likelihood that the user problem is actually closed.
metrics.single_view_value: Prevent false close and trigger repair before exit.
metrics.org_view_value: Measure true outcome completion versus vanity engagement.

metrics.single_view_value: Route to helper, simplifier, or human escalation.

metrics.meaning: Speed and consistency of movement toward outcome.
metrics.single_view_value: Identify when to push, pause, clarify or package an offer.
metrics.org_view_value: Forecast pipeline velocity and stalled lanes.

metrics.meaning: Likelihood the interaction or workflow will be dropped.
metrics.single_view_value: Save the session with a next-best action.
metrics.org_view_value: Find funnel leakage and operational neglect.

metrics.meaning: Spread and scatter of topics within a conversation or workstream.
metrics.org_view_value: Detect unclear brands, products and internal operating models.

metrics.meaning: How new a signal is compared with prior corpus and registry.
metrics.single_view_value: Capture invention and unusual opportunity moments.
metrics.org_view_value: Feed R&D, IP harvesting and Commercial Widget discovery.

metrics.meaning: How many system, actor, data or process dependencies attach to the item.
metrics.single_view_value: Expose hidden blockers and orchestration needs.
metrics.org_view_value: Map system fragility and integration risk.

metrics.meaning: Whether trust appears to be rising, flat or falling.
metrics.single_view_value: Adjust tone, evidence level and escalation.
metrics.org_view_value: Track brand and agent credibility over time.

metrics.meaning: Likelihood the user will act, buy, approve or continue.
metrics.single_view_value: Trigger deal shaping or next-best conversion action.

metrics.meaning: Estimated economic value per interaction, action or unit of effort.
metrics.org_view_value: Create ROI heatmaps across brands, widgets and workflows.

metrics.meaning: Percentage of loops closed with evidence under AGL rules.
metrics.single_view_value: Stop pretending a job is complete.

metrics.org_view_value: Power audit-grade governance and promotion gates.

metrics.meaning: Time from signal arrival to useful insight or action.
Value lost as action is delayed.

composite_indices.use: Gate production promotion and detect fake done.
Prioritise actions, offers and workflows by commercial impact.
Route unclear work to analysis, clarification or restructuring.
Decide AUTO, LOG, GATED or BLOCKED execution tier.
Harvest new Commercial Widgets, IP and product lanes.

required_build_actions: Design idempotent Supabase schema for raw signals, derived metrics, composites, and evidence bindings with PKs, timestamps and RLS.
Create ingestion contract for real-time chat/thread/event telemetry.
Create scoring workers for raw metric calculation and composite index generation.
Attach audit.evidence_register and audit.reality_ledger evidence state to all generated claims/actions.
Create WIP/PEN auto-job extraction rules for high-value abandoned ideas, high novelty, high friction, and high opportunity decay.
Create Command Centre widgets for single-interaction view and organisation-level heatmaps.
Add test harness with sample telemetry payloads and expected composite outputs.
Emit runtime receipt and final build closure evidence.

definition_of_done.schema: Tables, views and policies exist; migration is idempotent.
definition_of_done.ingestion: Sample event batch is accepted and stored.
definition_of_done.scoring: Raw metrics and composite scores are generated deterministically.
definition_of_done.routing: At least one sample signal creates a WIP/PEN job with idempotency key.
definition_of_done.evidence: Evidence rows bind job, runtime output and reality state.
definition_of_done.visibility: CC widget or exported dashboard artifact shows single and org views.
definition_of_done.closure: Receipt written to receipts/runtime and final evidence_state is REAL or PARTIAL with exact gaps.
